items.title: [Bug]: schema-invalid jobs index prevents fallback to a healthy jobs.json
items.description:
### Bug Type
Portal: website not loading or showing stale data

### Description
The browser's fallback from `jobs-index.json` to `jobs.json` handles HTTP / JSON-decoding failures, but not a successful JSON response with an invalid jobs schema. If the index answers HTTP 200 with `{ "nope": 1 }` while `jobs.json` contains valid postings, `loadJobs` returns an error and zero jobs without requesting the healthy full dataset.

Verified against `main` at `c73256709`; the relevant files are unchanged from that commit. This is a deterministic fault-injection reproduction, not evidence that production currently serves an invalid index.

### Steps to Reproduce
Run from the repository root:

```sh
node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import { loadJobs } from './site/src/data/jobs-source.js';
const calls = [];
const fetchImpl = async (url) => {
  calls.push(url);
  return {
    ok: true,
    json: async () => url.endsWith('jobs-index.json')
      ? { nope: 1 }
      : { jobs: [{ job_id: 'job_valid', title: 'Junior Engineer', company: 'Example' }] },
  };
};
const result = await loadJobs(fetchImpl, false);
console.log({ calls, jobs: result.jobs.length, error: result.error });
JS
```

Actual:

```text
calls: ['./jobs-index.json']
jobs: 0
error: 'jobs payload has no "jobs" array'
```

Expected: `jobs.json` is requested, its valid posting is returned, and `error` is null.

### Cause
In [`jobs-source.js`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/data/jobs-source.js), the inner `try/catch` protects only the index fetch/decode. `normalizeJobsPayload(payload)` runs after that catch, so a schema error goes straight to the outer failure handler and bypasses the fallback.

The existing “reports a malformed payload” test supplies only an invalid index. It does not provide a healthy full file or assert that fallback was attempted.

### Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Index loading is considered successful only after schema validation and normalization succeed.
- [ ] A schema-invalid index triggers a request for `jobs.json`.
- [ ] A valid full payload restores jobs and returns `error: null`.
- [ ] A valid empty index (`jobs: []`) remains a successful empty result, without fallback.
- [ ] When both candidates fail, the loader resolves with an explicit error rather than rejecting or silently reporting success.
- [ ] Add deterministic tests for invalid index + healthy full payload, both invalid, and valid empty index; cover schema-invalid Brotli index payloads as applicable.

### Validation
Reproduced with the injected fetch above. Existing checks also pass: `vitest run src/lib/share.test.js src/data/data-sources.test.js test/seo.test.js` (**50 passed**).

Searched open and closed issues for index/fallback/malformed-payload reports; no issue tracking this specific jobs-loader recovery gap was found.

items.title: [Bug]: near-miss job share links point to static pages that are never generated
items.description:
### Bug Type
Portal: broken link or incorrect data displayed

### Description
“Copy link to this job” produces a static `/job/<job_id>/` URL for a near-miss posting, even though the SEO build generates these pages only for the curated dataset. The copied link therefore points to a page the deployment does not contain.

Verified against `main` at `c73256709`. The relevant source and fixture files are unchanged from that commit. This is reproduced locally using committed fixtures; no live posting counts are asserted.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Build the fixture site (`cd site && npm run build:fixtures`).
2. Open the board and enable **WIDEN SCOPE → internships & co-ops**.
3. Select the fixture posting `job_e001ffffffffffffffff` (Palantir, Software Engineer Intern - Summer 2027).
4. Click “Copy link to this job”. The URL is `https://jobs.riteshrana.engineer/job/job_e001ffffffffffffffff/` (or the equivalent preview origin).
5. Inspect `site/dist/job/job_e001ffffffffffffffff/index.html`: it does not exist. Opening the copied URL cannot restore that posting.

Independent local verification called `generateSeo` directly on `site/test/fixtures`: it generated 19 curated job pages, while the page for this near-miss ID was absent. Calling `jobShareUrl(mapJob(nearMiss), location)` returned the missing static-page URL.

### Cause
- [`share.js`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/lib/share.js) selects the static path for every valid `jobId`, without considering `nearMiss`.
- [`DashboardView.jsx`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/components/hiring/DashboardView.jsx) uses that helper for both curated and widened-scope rows.
- [`generate.mjs`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/scripts/seo/generate.mjs) reads `jobs.json` / `jobs-index.json`, not `jobs-extended.json`.

### Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Copied links for near misses open the board with the selected posting restored.
- [ ] The link includes every required `include` reason so the receiving browser loads the extended dataset and can display the posting, including postings with multiple reasons.
- [ ] Curated postings retain their existing static job-page links.
- [ ] Links work at the domain root and under a GitHub Pages subpath.
- [ ] Curated counts, feeds, and SEO job-page scope remain unchanged.
- [ ] Add deterministic unit coverage plus an integration/E2E case that opens a copied near-miss link in a fresh view.

### Validation and Related Issues
`vitest run src/lib/share.test.js src/data/data-sources.test.js test/seo.test.js`: **50 passed**. The gap is not exercised by those tests.

Related to #181, but distinct: the current React detail view and URL state already exist. This report concerns the wrong destination produced by the current share action specifically for the near-miss tier.

items.title: [Product Bug] Jobs auto-detected as "Applied" remain visible in "Liked" tab (cross-tab duplication)
items.description:
Hi Jobright team. Filing here because this repo is the most public-visible surface; please route to the extension / web-app product team.

### Bug

After the Chrome extension auto-detects a submitted application, the job stays in **both** the "Liked" tab AND the "Applied" tab. User has to manually un-Like each one or Liked-tab counts inflate indefinitely.

### Repro

1. Save a job to the Liked list (click heart/save on a job card)
2. Apply to that same job on the external careers page
3. Return to Jobright dashboard
4. Observe: job appears in both Applied AND Liked

### Expected

Once auto-detect flips a job to Applied, it should disappear from Liked. "Applied" supersedes "Liked" in the user's pipeline model: you don't "like" a job you've already committed to.

### Impact

Breaks pipeline tracking integrity. Any user with 20+ liked jobs who applies to a few per day accumulates a growing phantom Liked list that no longer reflects pipeline state. Appears to be a recurring class of complaint in third-party Jobright reviews (weak submission tracking).

### One-click diagnostic for your eng team

Hard-refresh the Liked tab after reproducing:

- **Duplicate persists**: backend data model issue (likely independent `isLiked` + `isApplied` boolean flags with no mutex, or separate collections with no cross-delete on apply-event)
- **Duplicate clears**: frontend cache-invalidation miss on apply-event (likely Chrome extension writes applied status without invalidating the Liked-list query)

### Fix sketch

- **Write-side**: on apply-event, set `isLiked=false` as well, OR migrate to a single `status` enum (liked / applied / interviewing / rejected) that is mutually exclusive
- **Query-side (belt-and-suspenders)**: filter Liked by `isLiked AND status != 'applied' AND status != 'interviewing'` so the bug cannot recur via other write paths

### Severity

**High**. Not critical (no data loss, no security issue), but breaks the extension's core value prop of trustworthy pipeline tracking. 200K users times this friction = material NPS impact.

Happy to provide screenshots if that unblocks routing.

items.description:
## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Fique atento ao redirecionamento que vai te levar para uma url [https://coodesh.com](https://coodesh.com/jobs/ads-solutions-engineering-manager-english-portuguese-181723690?utm_source=github&utm_medium=backend-br-vagas&modal=open) para realizar a candidatura. 👋 Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.

In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 10 years of experience working with client-side web technologies (e.g., HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or HTTP).
  • 10 years of experience coding with one or more programming languages (e.g., Java, C/C++, Python).
  • 5 years of experience managing a technical team in a cloud computing environment or customer-facing role.
  • Experience in technical leadership, including experience leading business transformation initiatives.
  • Ability to communicate in English and Portuguese fluently to engage with local stakeholders.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Direct experience as a people manager for a software engineering or technical solutions team.
  • Technical expertise in building scalable systems, APIs, or data pipelines, with the ability to lead technical discussions and contribute to design decisions.
  • Experience in the ad-tech industry.
  • Strong project management skills and experience leading teams through the full software development lifecycle (ideation, design, implementation, launch, and support).
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a passion for developing talent and building a positive team culture.

About the job

gTech Ads is responsible for all support and media and technical services for customers big and small across our entire Ad products stack. We help our customers get the most out of our Ad and Publisher products and guide them when they need help. We provide a range of services from enabling better self help and in-product support, to providing better support through interactions, setting up accounts and implementing ad campaigns, and providing media solutions for customers business and marketing needs and providing complex technical and measurement solutions along with consultative support for our large customers. These solutions range from bespoke and customized ones for our customers to scalable support for millions of customers worldwide. Based on the evolving needs of our ads customers, we partner with Sales, Product and Engineering teams within Google to develop better solutions, tools, and services to improve our products and enhance our client experience. As a cross-functional and global team, we ensure our customers get the best return on investment with Google and we remain a trusted partner.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

To learn more about gTech, check out our video.

Responsibilities

  • Be a dedicated people manager for a team of individual contributors. Hire, set clear expectations, coaching team members, providing feedback, supporting career development, and creating a high-trust environment where your team can do their best work.
  • Own the day-to-day execution of the engineering roadmap in partnership with GCS teams. Manage project timelines, unblock technical challenges, and be accountable for the on-time delivery of your team's projects.
  • Act as the primary technical mentor for your team. Lead design reviews, participate in code reviews, and set a high bar for engineering excellence, ensuring the solutions team builds are reliable, scalable, and maintainable.
  • Work with other engineering managers, product managers, and the gAP Delivery teams to ensure team's work is aligned with organization's goals. Communicate status, risks, and progress to the gAP Engineering lead and other stakeholders.

items.title: [Remoto] Desenvolvedor Fullstack Pleno - Java & Angular - DB1
items.description:
<!-- Por favor, poste apenas vagas para backend. -->

## Nossa empresa

Na DB1, cada linha de código, teste ou insight é uma chance de criar impacto real. Somos movidos pela curiosidade e pelo desejo de transformar problemas complexos em soluções que simplificam a vida das pessoas. Gostamos de experimentar, aprender e inovar, e por isso esse é o lugar para colocar seu talento à prova.

Se você combina inteligência com uma vontade incansável de aprender e evoluir, e tem uma postura resiliente moldado por superações, já carrega muito da essência DB1. Aqui, cada desafio é oportunidade de crescimento, cada erro é uma lição para voltar mais forte e cada vitória é combustível para seguir adiante com uma missão clara e valores sólidos que dão sentido a cada passo. Na DB1, superação não é exceção e sim parte da jornada.
## Descrição da vaga

No Anymarket, você vai construir o coração das nossas integrações, sistemas robustos, escaláveis e que atravessam times diferentes, do backend ao frontend. Sua missão começa pela imersão: entender o que existe, como funciona e por quê foi construído assim. A partir daí, você vai ganhar autonomia para evoluir essas soluções e habilitar a escala que o produto precisa para crescer.

No dia a dia, você vai trabalhar com times multidisciplinares de tecnologia, negócio e design, sempre com IA como aliada no fluxo de desenvolvimento, geração e revisão de código, análise de logs, automação de tarefas e spec-driven development fazem parte da rotina. Você vai escrever código que resiste ao tempo, do tipo que nasce forte desde o primeiro commit e continua de pé anos depois.
## Local

Remoto

## Requisitos

Perfil que buscamos:

- Experiência sólida em Java com Spring Boot e/ou Quarkus, não só domínio do framework, mas entendimento do que acontece por trás dele
- Domínio de Angular para construção de interfaces administrativas e dashboards
- Experiência com PostgreSQL ou banco relacional equivalente
- Vivência com Redis ou similar para caching
- Experiência com mensageria assíncrona: Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ ou similar
- Conhecimento do ciclo completo de deploy: Docker, Kubernetes e CI/CD
- Vivência real com arquitetura de microsserviços
- Experiência com monitoramento em tempo real: Datadog, Grafana, ELK ou similar
- IA incorporada ao fluxo de trabalho: geração e revisão de código, RAG, spec-driven development (SDD)
- Quando trava num problema, busca ativamente a solução, questiona colegas, pesquisa, decompõe em partes menores
- Assume responsabilidade pelos próprios erros e colabora genuinamente em equipe

Vai ser incrível se você souber ou tiver vontade de aprender:

- MongoDB ou outro banco não-relacional
- AWS em nível intermediário
- Análise de performance em produção
- Ferramentas de análise estática de código (Sonar/SAST)
- Fluxos de autenticação OAuth2/PKCE

## Benefícios

Cartão de benefícios flexíveis (Alimentação, Mobilidade, Qualidade de Vida, entre outras categorias);
Plano de Saúde Unimed;
Seguro de Vida;
Plano odontológico (opcional);
Crédito Consignado com as melhores taxas (Mixtra);
Gift Aniversário;
Bem-estar: parceria com plataforma de acesso a academias e outras atividades físicas, parceria para atendimento psicológico;
Evolução de carreira: Parceria com plataformas e instituições de ensino, tanto para idiomas quanto para graduação, pós-graduação e cursos livres, Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI), feedbacks constantes, Programa de Mentoria, eventos internos, subsídio para treinamentos, universidade corporativa e muito mais;
Programas de recompensa: bônus para indicação de novos colaboradores e bônus anual atrelado a metas;
Espaço para assumir desafios e se desenvolver.
## Contratação

CLT
